# School_Management_System

> A learning-focused school administration and fee management platform built with ASP.NET Core, Blazor Interactive Server, EF Core, and MySQL.

## Project documents

- [README](README.md): current repository status, planned stack, and module overview
- [Implementation plan](plan.md): architecture, roles, data model, workflows, calculations, and seven-phase roadmap
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): implementation workflow, coding guidance, and data-protection rules
- [Full AI context](llms-full.txt): expanded project summary
- [MIT License](LICENSE): repository license

## Current status

Phase 1's migration is applied to the local MySQL database. Phase 2 source includes anonymous admission applications, private document uploads, role-protected review and approval, atomic student enrollment, paginated student search, profile updates, and CSV export. The solution builds and the admissions route serves. Complete the manual workflow in the Phase 2 guide before relying on the full admissions flow. Later roadmap modules remain planned.
